lax.definition:
s. lacking in rigor or strictness
a. pronounced with muscles of the tongue and jaw relatively relaxed (e.g., the vowel sound in `bet')
a. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience
s. emptying easily or excessively
lax.translation:
a. 松的, 不严格的, 腹泻的, 松弛的
n. 腹泻, 松元音

lax judgment.translation: [法] 宽判, 马虎的判决

lax-friedrichs scheme.translation: [计] 拉克斯-弗里特列赫格式

lax-wendroff scheme.translation: [计] 拉克斯-冯特洛夫格式

laxation.definition:
n the elimination of fecal waste through the anus
n the act of making something less tight
laxation.translation:
n. 松弛, 驰缓, 轻泻剂
[医] 排粪, 松驰

laxative.definition:
n. a mild cathartic
a. stimulating evacuation of feces
laxative.translation:
a. 通便的, 轻度腹泻的
n. 通泻剂, 缓泻药

laxativeness.definition: n. The quality of being laxative.
laxativeness.translation: n. 轻度腹泻, 放肆

laxatives.translation: n. 轻泻剂, 通便剂( laxative的复数形式 )

laxator.definition:
n. That which loosens; -- esp., a muscle which by its
   contraction loosens some part.

laxer.definition:
s. lacking in rigor or strictness
a. pronounced with muscles of the tongue and jaw relatively relaxed (e.g., the vowel sound in `bet')
a. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience
laxer.translation: a. 不严格的( lax的比较级 ); 马虎的; 松懈的; <医>（肠）宽松的

laxest.definition:
s. lacking in rigor or strictness
a. pronounced with muscles of the tongue and jaw relatively relaxed (e.g., the vowel sound in `bet')
a. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience
laxest.translation: a. 不严格的( lax的最高级 ); 马虎的; 松懈的; <医>（肠）宽松的

laxitas gingivarum.translation: [医] 龈松驰, 软龈, 海绵状龈

laxitas ventriculi.translation: [医] 胃松驰, 胃无紧张

laxities.translation: 松弛( laxity的名词复数 )；散漫；（肠的）松动；泻肚

laxity.definition:
n the condition of being physiologically lax
n the quality of being lax and neglectful
laxity.translation:
n. 松弛, 不检点
[医] 松驰, 无紧张

laxly.definition: r. in a permissively lenient manner
laxly.translation: adv. 松驰地, 缓慢地

laxman.translation: n. (Laxman)人名；(芬、尼)拉克斯曼；(葡)拉什曼

laxness.definition:
n the quality of being lax and neglectful
n the condition of being physiologically lax
laxness.translation: 拉克斯内斯(①姓氏 ②HalldЕr Kiljan, 1902-, 冰岛作家, 曾获1955年诺贝尔文学奖)

laxtons.translation: (Laxton 的复数) n. (Laxton)人名；(英)拉克斯顿
